title: In accordance with the provisions of Chapter 150 of the Acts of 1950 the Commission of the Department of Public Utilities hereby makes an assessment on the Intra-state revenues of selected electric companies to restore the integrated Resources Management Fund, to reimburse the Department for expenditures in excess of the estimate for FY1997 and to provide an estimate of $887,844.38 for FY1998.
filings: ORDER ISSUED Commissioners: Howe, Besser 97-64D DPU
